plain: Of the councils in ancient Greece where states met to settle shared matters.

webster.text: Pertaining to the august council of Amphictyons.

example.quote: The Amphictyonic confederacy, of which she had been a member, left her in the full exercise of her government and her legislation.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 18 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 7, 1787
